_comment: 1.21: `bonus` perks come free at their level (no choice), on top of the two-way choices at perkLevels. 1.8.5 Skills. Four skills level 1-10 by doing what players already do (src/systems/Skills.ts). xpLevels[n] = total XP needed to reach level n+1. xp maps a game stat (an incStat name) to the XP each count gives. Each level gives the 'perLevel' bonus (numbers in 'values'); at levels 5 and 10 the player picks one of two perks. All numbers here can be tuned without code changes (see BALANCE.md > Skills). 1.35 Higher Ground: levels 11-20 (expert ranks). Each rank above 10 gives half the perLevel bonus (expertStep); perk choices at 15 and 20, and a free bonus at 12 and 18 in every skill.
